source_authority: Department of Financial Services, Government of India
text: The Department of Financial Services states that Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was launched on 28 August 2014 as the National Mission for Financial Inclusion. Its focus was later shifted from providing at least one basic bank account to every household to covering every unbanked adult. The scheme offers an unbanked person a Basic Savings Bank Deposit account with no minimum-balance requirement, a free RuPay debit card with built-in accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh, and access to an overdraft facility of up to Rs. 10,000 subject to eligibility conditions. PMJDY also provides access to banking services in rural areas through Bank Mitras and promotes awareness of financial products through financial-literacy programmes.
title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana - Department of Financial Services
